query: In the construction industry, a set of managers and a set of construction projects are given. Assigning manager i to project j incurs a cost that depends on the manager‚Äôs experience and expertise. These costs are provided in the CSV file "manager_project_costs.csv", where each row corresponds to a manager and each column corresponds to a project. The task is to determine a minimum-cost one-to-one assignment of managers to projects, such that each manager is assigned to exactly one project and each project is assigned to exactly one manager.
